blocks.text: Applications use the configured launchers and profile-selected graphics policy. Intel, AMD and optional NVIDIA support differ by host. Read the related manuals for the selected graphics policy; a driver file is not proof that a GPU is active.

The Waybar application launcher's context menu offers GTK, Qt, Electron and Wayland/OpenGL diagnostic profiles. Use the matching profile only when you deliberately need a bounded local report, and remove sensitive information before sharing it.

Start with the failing application's ordinary native launcher and its logs. Avoid global environment overrides, disabling security profiles or enabling Vulkan/Xwayland as a blanket fix. Retain the existing private Zoom/Discord compatibility path.
